decision.reasoning_trace: Upon reviewing the product feed, I noticed a high number of irrelevant results like camping stoves, tents, and even dog shirts that were mislabeled. I narrowed my consideration set to actual backpack products with high ratings and solid review counts. Among these, the ZOMAKE 20L stood out as the best value for a general-purpose daypack. It has over 14,000 reviews and a 4.6 rating, and its packable nature makes it very convenient for the price of $13.99. While the G4Free tactical pack and the specialized fishing/ski bags were high quality, the ZOMAKE offers the best utility for a casual shopper.
